create.name: Amy Belair
create.bio:
Amy Belair is a cosmic oracle, channel, and Akashic Records reader whose gifts awakened through the deepest grief a mother can know: the loss of her newborn son, twenty days old. That shattering, she says, activated the dormant psychic abilities that led her to the Akashic Records — and transformed a former doula and midwife into a guide for souls instead. She describes her work now as translation: receiving multidimensional “light codes” and rendering them into plain English for humans ready to awaken, a role she inhabits with the devotion of someone who treats her business, in her own words, as a ministry.

Amy is the channel of The Priestess Transmissions (with Amron Bevels) — received during the Great Conjunction of 2020 — the host of the top-rated Third Eye Awakening podcast, and a mentor to lightworkers developing their intuitive gifts through her courses, workshops, and Akashic readings. A devoted mother whose path has woven birth and loss, surrender and strength into a single teaching, she offers seekers what she found on the far side of her own heartbreak: that our gifts often arrive wrapped in our greatest pain, waiting to be reclaimed.

courses.title: How to Read the Akashic Records: The Masterclass
courses.description: Amy’s signature training in accessing the Akashic Records, the ancient repository of every soul’s experiences. It’s designed for beginners and experienced practitioners alike, and teaches you to open your own Records for personal growth, life purpose and spiritual insight.

courses.title: Creation Codes
courses.description: A 12-week live group immersion for lightworkers, starseeds and awakening souls. It covers telepathy, blindfolded vision, channelling and conscious creation. It includes weekly Zoom mentorship and activation calls, a 24/7 Telegram community, and a private portal with all replays and transmissions.

courses.title: Magic in the Dark
courses.description: Born from Amy’s own experience of profound loss, this programme helps you transmute trauma and find your magic in life’s darkest passages. It includes seven chakra-clearing meditations, seven deep-dive modules and guided visualisations.

courses.title: Anchoring in Your Highest Timeline Workshop
courses.description: A three-hour workshop on how timeline shifting really works. You’ll identify your highest accessible timeline and the aligned actions that anchor you into it. It’s a focused, practical session for anyone ready to quantum leap into their next chapter.

courses.title: Remembering Lemuria
courses.description: A channelled Akashic Key Transmission about our ancient history in the times of Lemuria and Atlantis, and humanity’s arrival through the Stargates. It includes a group Akashic Records reading and a soul clearing and anointing.

courses.title: The Holographic Field of Light
courses.description: A three-part audio series on accessing the Christ Light frequency to heal, create and psychically activate in the Akashic Field. The parts cover the Christ Consciousness Frequency, the Organic Matrix Reality and working with the Holographic Field.

free_resources.title: The 3 Stages of Awakening
free_resources.description: A free guide that maps spiritual awakening into three stages: Caterpillar & Cocoon, Dragonfly & Butterfly, and Angelics & Dragons. Each stage describes what you may be experiencing and pairs it with recommended free podcast episodes, so you can find where you are on the path and what comes next.
